csv_scope_of_work: The Webster City, City Council may be seeking a Developers for Lotus Building Downtown Revitalization .The downtown committee recommends the city apply for an Emergency Catalyst Grant. This will require a $100,000 City match to repair the roof and wall. Webster City would first be deeded the building by Lotus, requiring Lotus to cease operations during repairs while the city issues RFPs (Request for Proposals) for a developer to purchase the building and complete upper-story apartments. This building is located at 707 Second Street
